prompt: Your practice tracker for learning to code shows you miss every Wednesday, when a club runs late. What is the best response?

options.text: Scrap the tracker — the habit has clearly failed
Move Wednesday's practice to a free slot on Thursday morning and keep tracking
Do double practice on other days to make up for the misses
Fill in the Wednesdays as done so the streak looks unbroken

explanation: The tracker is doing its job: it shows the slot, not the habit, is the problem. Moving practice to a time that actually exists keeps the routine honest and sustainable.
